speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent heart attack and the presence of bloody stools, I am concerned about blood flow to your intestines. Does the pain feel disproportionately severe compared to what you see on physical exam, and have you noticed any distension or tenderness in your abdomen?

speaker: Patient

text: Given your recent myocardial infarction and the classic presentation of severe pain with bloody stools, I suspect acute mesenteric ischemia. REQUEST TEST: CT Angiography of the abdomen and pelvis.
